SSH literal field-range audit controllers.

The manifest pins exact original source bytes and existing source-archive dependencies. Full captures, expected field grids, neutral facts, runtime exports, logs and images remain outside Git. Public preservation checks prove only that old interpretations were retained except for source-derived ranges; authored source49/50 checks provide independent field/range truth. Historical controller failures are retained and distinguished from product defects.

The subsequent single-tree display and sealed-line-oracle correction are separate implementation steps; this archive does not turn their pending checks into completed evidence.
